edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit sender when transfer forwards to transferFrom
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom with msg.sender, _to and _value
_to is the recipient credited in transferFrom
_value drives all balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom
_from is the debited source address in transferFrom
msg.sender is checked against allowance and used by ensure in transferFrom
transferFrom gates execution through the ensure check
transferFrom reads and mutates the allowance mapping
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented in transferFrom
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for both source and destination
balanceOf is read to verify sufficiency in transferFrom
allowance subtraction is performed without SafeMath underflow protection
balanceOf debit/credit is performed without SafeMath overflow protection
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom

_minSale enforces the minimum transfer amount in condition
_maxSale enforces the maximum transfer amount in condition

amount parameter drives the arithmetic in transferFrom and should be folded into it
source address parameter is consumed only by transferFrom and should be folded into it
spender parameter is consumed only by approve and should be folded into it
target address parameter belongs to the delegate wrapper and should be folded into it
calldata parameter flows directly into the unsafe delegatecall and should be folded there
recipient array parameter is consumed only by batchSend and should be folded into it
address parameter is consumed only by setTradeAddress and should be folded into it
beneficiary parameter is consumed only by _mints and should be folded into it
mint amount parameter is consumed only by _mints and should be folded into it
sale count parameter is consumed only by init and should be folded into it
minimum sale parameter is consumed only by init and should be folded into it
maximum sale parameter is consumed only by init and should be folded into it
name parameter is consumed only by the constructor and should be folded into it
symbol parameter is consumed only by the constructor and should be folded into it
supply parameter is consumed only by the constructor and should be folded into it
